title: Voyager cup file
description: A cup: a name, a game mode and the rotation of maps it plays, in order. Describes the format the catalogue adapters in voyager-platform read. The loader does not validate against this document at runtime; the adapters are the runtime check. The map names are checked against the map files by the loader, not by this schema.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, so editors can find it.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the file format this file is written in. Absent means 1. This schema describes version 1 only.

name.description: The cup's name. Must not be blank.

mode.description: RACE scores and ranks; PRACTICE does not.

mapNames.description: The maps of the rotation, in the order they are played. Each must name a map file's name.

notes.description: Free text for the person editing the file. Ignored by the loader.
